content_sections.heading: Official Source
content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Kaimur at Bhabua, dated 21 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Kaimur Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Kaimur Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Stenographer, 1 Clerk, 1 Peon/Orderly.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Kaimur Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application form on pages 3 and 4 of this notice) and send it to Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Kaimur at Bhabua, by in person or by registered post, to reach by 21 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No amount printed; remuneration is governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants must be retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the last three years, as per Patna High Court guidelines, with satisfactory service records and no major disciplinary punishment. Stenographer: experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. Clerk: knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work. Peon/Orderly: capable of performing the duties of the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties of the respective post. Must possess satisfactory service records. Must perform duties for a minimum of 05 hours on each working day.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons who are not retired employees of the Civil Courts. Retired court employees who retired more than three years earlier, as per Patna High Court guidelines. Applicants who were subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement is purely contractual and can be terminated at any time as per directions of the Hon'ble High Court Patna. Period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions governed by applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. Engagement confers no right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Evening Court, Civil Court, Kaimur at Bhabua.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Recent passport size photograph (self attested); Medical fitness certificate issued by Civil Surgeon; Status of any FIR or criminal case registered or pending, if any; Aadhaar number (mandatory); List of documents attached.
